nodes.description: Total ROUTE token supply, set to 20_000_000e18 and minted to deployer at construction.
Internal mapping of token balances per account; mutated in _transferTokens and constructor.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>allowance; written by approve, permit and transferFrom.
Mapping of delegator to current delegatee used for vote checkpointing.
Mapping account=>index=>Checkpoint storing vote history (fromBlock, votes).
Number of stored vote checkpoints per account.
Public per-address nonce mapping used by meta transactions, permit and delegateBySig.
Cached EIP-712 domain separator computed once through the initializer modifier.
Initializable guard flag preventing _initializeEIP712 from being executed twice.
Payable meta-transaction entry point: builds MetaTransaction, verifies signature, bumps nonce then low-level calls itself with functionSignature+userAddress appended.
EIP-2612 style permit: recovers signer over PERMIT_TYPEHASH struct, checks nonce and deadline then writes allowance.
Delegates votes from a signatory recovered via ecrecover; checks nonce match and block.timestamp expiry.
External transfer of rawAmount from _msgSender() to dst.
External transferFrom that decrements spender allowance unless it is uint256(-1).
External approve setting allowances[_msgSender()][spender] to rawAmount (uint256(-1) means infinite).
Public delegate that forwards _msgSender() and delegatee to _delegate.
Internal _delegate: stores delegatee and moves the delegator balance of votes.
Internal _transferTokens: zero-address checks, checked sub/add on balances, emits Transfer and moves delegates.
Internal _moveDelegates: adjusts vote counts of source and destination representatives through checkpoints.
Internal _writeCheckpoint: records or updates a vote checkpoint for the current block number.
Helper that converts raw amount to uint256; contains no real upper-bound check.
Checked addition helper requiring c >= a to prevent overflow.
Checked subtraction helper requiring b <= a to prevent underflow.
Helper converting uint to uint32 with a require n < 2**32 bound.
Signature-extension style sender resolution: if msg.sender == address(this) the trailing 20 bytes of calldata are used, otherwise msg.sender.
Internal verify: rejects address(0) and compares signer with ecrecover of the typed meta-transaction hash.
Internal hashing of the MetaTransaction struct with META_TRANSACTION_TYPEHASH.
Route constructor that mints totalSupply to _msgSender() and emits Transfer from address(0).
Public pure helper returning chainid() via inline assembly.
Internal _setDomainSeperator building the EIP-712 domain separator from name, version, address(this) and chain id.
Binary search over checkpoints returning the vote count of an account at a past block number.
External view returning allowances[account][spender].
External view returning balances[account].
External view returning the latest checkpointed vote count of an account.
Caller-controlled msg.sender, used as relayer, owner of allowances, transfer source and delegation origin.
Miner-influenced block.timestamp compared against permit deadline and delegateBySig expiry.
Low-level address(this).call(abi.encodePacked(functionSignature, userAddress)) enabling arbitrary self-calls from the meta-transaction path.
ecrecover call inside permit used to authorize allowance changes.
ecrecover call inside delegateBySig used to authorize vote delegation.
ecrecover call inside verify used to validate meta-transaction signatures.
Integer addition of balances/votes guarded by a require(c >= a) overflow check.
Integer subtraction of balances/votes guarded by a require(b <= a) underflow check.
Meta-transaction signer address supplied by the relayer caller.
Arbitrary calldata blob executed through the contract's own low-level call.
ECDSA signature r component.
ECDSA signature s component.
ECDSA signature v recovery byte.
Owner address in permit whose allowance is being granted.
Spender address receiving the allowance.
Raw amount supplied by the caller before safe256 normalisation.
Permit expiration timestamp compared against block.timestamp.
Delegatee receiving votes.
Delegation nonce supplied with the signature and matched against nonces[signatory].
Delegation signature expiry timestamp compared against block.timestamp.
Destination address of a token transfer.
Source address of a transferFrom.
Account address queried by view functions.
Historical block number requested in getPriorVotes.
Normalised uint256 amount derived from rawAmount.
In-memory MetaTransaction struct built during executeMetaTransaction.
success and returnData tuple returned by the low-level self call.
Locally recomputed EIP-712 domain separator in permit and delegateBySig.
Struct hash of the permit or delegation payload.
EIP-191 prefixed digest fed to ecrecover.
Address recovered by ecrecover, validated against owner or used as delegator.
Decremented spender allowance written back in transferFrom.
Cached allowances[src][spender] read in transferFrom.
Previous delegatee read in _delegate before reassignment.
Balance of the delegator whose votes are moved.
uint32 truncation of block.number used as checkpoint key.
Cached numCheckpoints value during getPriorVotes binary search.
Result c of the checked add/sub helper operations.

edges.reason: msg.sender is recorded as the relayer in the MetaTransactionExecuted event of executeMetaTransaction.
_msgSender inspects msg.sender to decide whether to decode the address appended to calldata.
approve sets the allowance owner from _msgSender(), i.e. ultimately msg.sender.
transfer takes the token source from _msgSender().
transferFrom derives the spender from _msgSender().
delegate delegates the votes of _msgSender() and is therefore caller-controlled.
permit compares block.timestamp to the supplied deadline, a timestamp dependency.
delegateBySig compares block.timestamp to the supplied expiry, a timestamp dependency.
userAddress populates the meta transaction nonce/from fields and the appended calldata.
functionSignature is carried inside the MetaTransaction struct before execution.
Arbitrary functionSignature is passed straight into the low-level self call.
permit requires the recovered signatory to equal owner.
deadline parameter bounds the lifetime of the permit signature.
nonce parameter must equal the stored nonce of the signatory.
expiry parameter bounds the lifetime of the delegation signature.
delegatee parameter is forwarded to _delegate after signature validation.
rawAmount becomes the allowance value in approve.
rawAmount becomes the transferred amount in transfer.
src identifies whose allowance and balance are consumed in transferFrom.
dst is the transfer destination in transfer.
account is used to read balances in balanceOf.
blockNumber selects the checkpoint to look up in getPriorVotes.
executeMetaTransaction requires the signature check performed by verify.
executeMetaTransaction performs an external low-level self call after bumping the nonce.
The self call can re-enter executeMetaTransaction, allowing nested meta-transaction execution.
The self call can dispatch into transfer with the appended userAddress used as _msgSender.
permit recovers the authorising signer with ecrecover.
delegateBySig recovers the authorising signer with ecrecover.
verify recovers the signer of the meta transaction with ecrecover.
verify hashes the meta transaction before recovering the signer.
permit embeds the chain id in its locally computed domain separator.
delegateBySig embeds the chain id in its locally computed domain separator.
_setDomainSeperator reads the chain id when building the separator.
_setDomainSeperator writes the cached domainSeperator state variable.
executeMetaTransaction increments nonces[userAddress] to prevent replay.
permit increments nonces[owner] inside the struct hash computation.
delegateBySig increments nonces[signatory] while matching the supplied nonce.
transfer normalises rawAmount through safe256.
transferFrom normalises rawAmount through safe256.
approve normalises rawAmount through safe256.
transferFrom decreases the spender allowance using the checked sub256 helper.
transfer delegates the balance movement to _transferTokens.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transferTokens.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance into the allowances mapping.
approve writes the new allowance into the allowances mapping.
permit writes the authorised allowance into the allowances mapping.
delegate forwards to the internal _delegate routine.
delegateBySig delegates votes from the recovered signatory.
_delegate stores the new delegatee in the delegates mapping.
_delegate moves the delegator balance of votes via _moveDelegates.
_transferTokens adds to the destination balance with the checked add256 helper.
_transferTokens subtracts from the source balance with the checked sub256 helper.
_transferTokens rewrites both source and destination entries of balances.
_transferTokens moves delegate votes after updating balances.
_moveDelegates adds incoming votes to the destination representative with add256.
_moveDelegates subtracts outgoing votes from the source representative with sub256.
_moveDelegates records the new vote totals through _writeCheckpoint.
_moveDelegates reads numCheckpoints to obtain the latest vote totals.
_writeCheckpoint truncates block.number to uint32 using safe32.
_writeCheckpoint writes the new Checkpoint entry into the checkpoints mapping.
_writeCheckpoint increments numCheckpoints for the delegatee.
add256 performs the guarded addition that can revert on overflow.
sub256 performs the guarded subtraction that can revert on underflow.
The constructor resolves the initial minter with _msgSender.
The constructor mints totalSupply into balances of the resolved sender.
The constructor reads totalSupply when minting the initial balance.
getPriorVotes reads numCheckpoints to bound its binary search.
getPriorVotes reads historical votes from the checkpoints mapping.
getCurrentVotes reads numCheckpoints to find the latest index.
getCurrentVotes reads the latest checkpoint votes value.
allowance reads allowances[account][spender].
balanceOf reads balances[account].

normalization_plan.reason: The meta transaction signer parameter only exists inside executeMetaTransaction and should be folded into its function node.
The calldata blob is only consumed by the low-level self call and adds no separate semantic meaning.
Signature component used solely by the meta transaction signature check.
Signature component used solely by the meta transaction signature check.
Signature component used solely by the meta transaction signature check.
Owner parameter is only meaningful as the authoriser of the permit call.
Spender parameter is only meaningful inside the approval flow.
Raw amount is normalised and consumed by the transfer path.
Deadline is only used for the permit expiry comparison.
Delegatee is only consumed by the internal delegation routine.
Nonce parameter is only checked inside delegateBySig.
Expiry parameter is only used for the delegation expiry comparison.
Destination parameter is only consumed by the internal transfer routine.
Source parameter is only consumed by the internal transfer routine.
Account parameter is used only for read-only balance lookups.
Block number parameter only drives the checkpoint binary search.
Normalised amount is an intermediate value of the approve computation.
The struct is a temporary representation of the meta transaction being executed.
The success/returnData tuple is the direct result of the low-level call.
Locally recomputed separator used only in the permit digest computation.
Struct hash is an intermediate value in the permit signature digest.
Digest exists only to be passed into the permit ecrecover call.
Recovered signer is the output of the permit ecrecover call.
Reduced allowance is the intermediate result written back by transferFrom.
Cached allowance read is only used within transferFrom.
Previous delegatee is a temporary read inside _delegate.
Delegator balance is a temporary read inside _delegate.
Truncated block number is a scratch value inside _writeCheckpoint.
Cached checkpoint count is a scratch value inside getPriorVotes.
The arithmetic result c is the direct output of the checked add/sub helpers.
